I meant the total cost of the initial crypt you draw.
If you draw the 2 1-cap, and 2 2-cap, you have a total capacity of 4 to bring out your full initial crypt.
If you draw the 4-cap vampires, you have a total capacity of 16 (4*4) to bring out your full initial crypt.
